ato.title: Avatar Texture Optimizer
ato.component.tooltip: Optimizes avatar textures: UV island remapping, quality-targeted rescaling, atlas packing, texture/material dedup. Runs after Modular Avatar, before Avatar Optimizer.
ato.progress.cancelling: Cancelling… resources will be released and the avatar is left unmodified.
ato.section.advancedQuality: Advanced quality parameters (custom tier) 高级质量参数（自定义档）
ato.advancedQuality.help: These are the explicit metric thresholds of the Custom tier. Switching tiers never overwrites them. They default to the lossless set. 这些是自定义档的显式指标阈值。切换档位不会覆盖它们，默认全部近无损。
ato.advancedQuality.customNote: A scaled island passes only when ALL metrics (SSIM + ΔE2000 + alpha + normal angle + gray RMSE + custom metrics) pass. 缩放岛仅在全部指标达标时通过。
ato.section.density: Pixel density (px per model meter) 像素密度（每模型米像素）
ato.atlas.minPadding: Minimum island padding (px) 最小岛间距
ato.section.import: Mipmaps & compression (per category) Mipmap 与压缩（按类别）
ato.platform.hint: Enable to override per-platform parameters (formats, mips, NPOT). Defaults follow the current build platform. 启用后按平台覆盖参数（格式/Mipmap/NPOT），默认值读取当前构建平台。
ato.report.summary: ATO finished: {0} islands -> {1} atlas pages; textures {2} -> {3} bytes ({4}% reduction).
ato.error.multipleComponents: ATO: multiple ATO components found under the avatar. Only one ATO component is allowed per avatar. Build aborted.
ato.error.missingDescriptor: ATO: the ATO component host object has no VRCAvatarDescriptor. Place the ATO component on the same object that carries the avatar descriptor. Build aborted.
ato.error.cancelled: ATO: the pipeline was cancelled by the user. The avatar was left unmodified; temporary assets were kept on disk.
